description: This Java class 'SingleLoanChargeRepaymentScheduleProcessingWrapper' handles processing of loan repayment schedule charges, including calculation of due, waived, and written-off charges, and adding charge-only repayment installments if required.

classes.name: SingleLoanChargeRepaymentScheduleProcessingWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for processing loan schedule charges, including recalculations, fee assessments, and installment adjustments.

methods.name: reprocess
methods.description: Recalculates and updates the repayment schedule with charges, interest, and principal, including handling of accruals and additional installments.

methods.name: calcChargeDue
methods.description: Calculates the amount of a charge due for a specific installment period based on charge type and calculation method.

methods.name: calcChargeWaived
methods.description: Calculates the waived amount for a specific charge during an installment period.

methods.name: calcChargeWrittenOff
methods.description: Calculates the written-off amount for a specific charge during an installment period.

methods.name: getInstallmentFee
methods.description: Determines the installment fee amount based on charge calculation type.

methods.name: getBaseAmount
methods.description: Calculates the base amount for charge calculations, considering principal and interest.

methods.name: addChargeOnlyRepaymentInstallmentIfRequired
methods.description: Adds a new repayment installment if a charge with a specific due date requires it.
